subject: Proposal: Priority Assurance Pack — commercial & credit options
thread_text:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Wu <j.wu@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Support tiers & credits — need options by EOW

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We scoped potential usage for our developer teams and procurement has asked for a clear set of options for SLA / premium support (uptime bands, response TTRs, escalation coverage) plus the associated pricing and any one-time onboarding credits you can offer.

Key asks from my side:
- 99.95 / 99.9 uptime tiers and the delta in credit exposure
- Target response windows for sev1 / sev2 and on-call coverage hours
- Any price breaks for a 12-month committed spend vs month-to-month
- How on-call escalation works (who owns first-line triage; when do engineers get looped in)

Would appreciate a simple matrix we can share with engineering and procurement. Need something by Friday.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Patel
Head of Platform, Acme Cloud

---

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Support tiers & credits — need options by EOW

Hi Aisha —

Thanks — attached is a short matrix and a pricing spreadsheet (see SLA-pricing-breakdown.xlsx). High level:
- Priority Assurance Pack A (99.95%): 24/7 triage, 1-hour response for Sev1, 4-hour for Sev2, named architect for rollouts.
- Priority Assurance Pack B (99.9%): business hours triage (8x5), 4-hour Sev1, 8-hour Sev2.

We can offer a one-time onboarding credit to offset the first invoice: 10% credit for a 6-month commit, 15% credit for a 12-month commit (applied as invoice credit across first two invoices). For larger annual commits we can also doorway a capped on-call allocation (up to 80 hours/quarter) so you don’t get surprise surge charges.

Escalation flow (brief):
1) Support tiers + runbook owned by Redwood CS for first 90 minutes.
2) If not mitigated, on-call engineer engaged and SOC/incident bridge opened.
3) Senior on-call escalation to product engineering if the bridge remains active after 3 hours.

I’ve copied Vanessa to confirm the commercial framing and Ben for billing/pricing. If this reads OK we’ll finalize the DocuSign and provide a tailored statement of work for onboarding.

(Attachment: Redwood_Priority_Assurance_Pack_v1.pdf)

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Support tiers & credits — need options by EOW

Aisha — quick note on packaging: based on similar customers, a practical middle ground is to set up a hybrid SLA where critical endpoints (inference API and key model routes) are covered at 99.95 while less-critical analytic endpoints get 99.9. That lets you keep cost profile lean while guaranteeing availability where it matters.

If you can share a small list of the top 5 routes and expected qps, we’ll map the pricing. Also happy to convert the onboarding credit into a billed retainer for a known amount of on-call hours (helps predict uplift).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

---

From: James Wu <j.wu@acmecloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support tiers & credits — need options by EOW

Thanks — we like the hybrid suggestion. A couple of asks from procurement side:
- Can Redwood offer a 20% discount on the 99.95 tier for a 12-month committed spend at our expected volume?
- Can the onboarding credit be paid upfront as a pre-burned retainer instead of a line-item credit?

Also, we need clarity on SLA credit caps — does Redwood cap total recoverable credits in a quarter?

—James
Procurement, Acme Cloud

---

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: James Wu <j.wu@acmecloud.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Support tiers & credits — need options by EOW

James — appreciate the specifics. Concessions summary:
- We can offer a 15% list discount on the 99.95 tier for a 12-month committed spend at the volumes you outlined; 20% is stretch for the initial contract but not impossible if we move to a 24-month commitment or a higher commit target.
- Onboarding credit: happy to accept as a pre-burned retainer that reduces billable on-call surges; we treat retained hours at the agreed bill rate and consume the retainer first.
- SLA credit caps: we cap quarterly recoverable credits at 10% of quarterly committed spend. Anything above that triggers contract review and remediation plans rather than further automatic credits.

If that framework is acceptable, Rishi can issue a clean commercial term sheet and we’ll prepare a DocuSign routing.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: SLA-pricing-breakdown.xlsx)
